old: A 1967 20-centavo coin from Mexico. The front shows Mexico's national coat of arms. The back shows the Pyramid of the Sun at Teotihuacan with the volcanoes Popocatépetl and Iztaccíhuatl behind it, a shining liberty cap above, a large 20, the word CENTAVOS, the date 1967, and the Mo mint mark. It is made of brass (95% copper and 5% zinc).
